source_component_correspondence.AffinityComparison: Exact original four-field source comparison and constructor guards; source base supplies its retained pairwise orientation.

source_component_correspondence.AffinityTraceBinding: Same shared support, full stored visits, exact tie edges, exclusion of strict order for equal traces, source no-distinguishable-cycle condition, comparison/trace retention under extension.
source_component_correspondence.AffinityRecordClosure: Exact projection from original held comparison to directed edge, complete source-record incidence, no added order, base and successor.
source_component_correspondence.AffinityRecurrenceBinding: Complete supplied registered-visit ledger is exactly the physical observation-equivalence ledger; binds source support and endpoint names, preserves original comparison, and proves exact tie class and visit append.

source_component_correspondence.AffinityEvidence: Original registration, census, closure, exclusions and controls.

source_component_correspondence.RedoxSealInputs: Original pinned redox derivation bytes and seal payload.
source_component_correspondence.AffinityExperiment: Original sealed categorical prediction, source identities and empirical boundary.
source_component_correspondence.AffinityValidation: Original multi-source authority extraction, custody, isolation, output fields, hashes and adverse control.

source_scope.boundary: Every finite pairwise comparison of two named atomic occurrences joined by one shared electron-labelled support.
source_scope.base: One pair of atoms and one shared support comparison supplies the first affinity relation.
source_scope.successor: Appending a pairwise comparison preserves all earlier traces and extends only by transitive closure; identical traces remain tied.
source_scope.quantification: The finite comparison and complete observation register are inputs ranging over the declared boundary. There is no additional requirement for one fixed global visit dataset or a new atom-specific numerical preference predictor.
source_scope.preserved: No original source field, constructor guard, accepted domain, candidate axis, elimination, control or empirical boundary changed.

result.reused_checks: Unchanged module SHA256 values compared with TURN_587. Source operation, program, empirical and independent checks reused; no constructor checks repeated. Combined current native import/axiom audit executed as audit_affinity596.py.

source_component_correspondence.PolarityExperiment: Original pre-sealed categorical prediction and source references; numerical empirical boundary unchanged.
